NAME: Kit Builder Preview
DESCRIPTION: Audible pad preview for Force Kit Builder: tap a pad's PLAY control on the shadow-mode touchscreen page (or the equivalent DETAIL-page control) to hear whatever sample is currently on that pad in the working kit, before ever exporting. No MIDI involved - see the shadow page's own engine_autostart, which starts/stops this process automatically as you enter/leave that page, instead of a manual toggle here. Requires the separate ForceAudioJack addon to be enabled (arms the shared injection tap at boot, zero voices) - this toggle only starts/stops the preview_host process itself, no LD_PRELOAD/acvs involved. Autoload is deliberately unavailable here: a voice must never be attached before an acvs restart, so it never starts at boot. Also requires ForceKitBuilder's own daemon.mjs to be running (it always is, from boot - see manage.sh) - this process only reads pad data through that daemon's control socket, it doesn't touch current-kit.json directly. See DESIGN.md's v3 scoping section.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: Kit Builder daemon's control socket path

ForceAudioJack voice slot (0-3; needs live confirmation - 0=Maze Voice, 1=JV-880, 2=DX7 per their own NSMODULE.json comments, 3 appears free but wasn't checked against the real device's /dev/shm - see DESIGN.md's v3 open items)
